spiritgiven.comments: Very lovely team both on and off the field, thank you for humility regardless of the score and we applaud you on how well you were able to adapt to the rule changes of wfdf :)

We thank you for improving the level of contact after communicating our discomfort however it did take multiple conversations for this to effectively occur. 
Communication was very strong both on field and off field, thank you for your lovely energy, positive attitude and great game
Thank you for the really lovely game, and taking care of our players as well as your own :)

We feel as if body awareness and self control & Rules knowledge and use could be improved - eg. foul call and players were still moving, some players on the mark wouldn’t put on stall counts
Overall a great spirited game - huge emphasis on the amazing positive attitude from everyone! Thank you girls :)
thanks for a very well spirited game and uplifting our girls as well as your own :)

thank you for the great and competitive game. Rules knowledge and use could be improved - eg. injury call play must be stopped, not dropping the stall / correcting marking infractions. Thank you to being receptive to our conversation regarding contact, however we feel it could still be improved upon. Thanks girls :)

Thank you for the great game. We felt as if your self control improved since our last game but rules knowledge and use could still be improved - eg. moving during a stoppage, in and out calls, making calls from the sidelines. Overall amazing game, thanks girls :)

There were a few instances where rules knowledge and use could be improved - such as out calls and violations. Also at times it felt as if discussions weren’t very constructive and competitiveness superseded spirit. Overall it was a great and fun game.

spiritreceived.comments: We believe they deserve a 13 because of their impressive fair-mindedness throughout the game as well as keeping a high level of self control and an excellent attitude towards each other and us. Calls were brief and discussed respectfully.
It was a really intense match but the spirit still was amazing, the girls were always lovely, kind and complimented to us a lot. Also comunication was extrimelly good and always respectfull!
There were a few instances of a lack of Rules knowledge and use specifically when calling in or out - only one foot needs to be down and in not both. Otherwise a really enjoyable match!
We love your energy, great communication, fair mindedness and that you’re so overall lovely people!
Great game. Great grabs, and adjustment to our zone. great spirit on and off the pitch. We wish you luck in the best of the tournament
Really nice team to play against. Good spirit the whole game. Any calls were resolved quickly and in good manner. Overall, a fun game to play!

Appreciative of them clarifying one of the rules with us that stirred some discussion. Perhaps you guys could also watch a little on the contact as there were instances when contact could have been avoided. Overall great game, you guys were generally patient and understanding throughout!
Such a fun game. Deeps, d’s and your teamwork with your continuations and flows were so impressive. Thanks so much for such a good match!

thanks for the great game, great communication on and off field generally,  v well but there was an instance when a stoppage was made but the call was not communicated across with clarityperhaps watch a bir on the bodying
